# Preamble

```{r}
#| label: preamble
#| message: false
#----------------------------
# clean environment
#----------------------------
rm(list=ls(all=TRUE))
#----------------------------
# source the config file
#----------------------------
library(here)
source(here("R","0-config.R"))
options(knitr.kable.NA = '-')
```

# Read in the data

```{r}
d1 <- read_rds(file = here("../../data/bangl/luminex/final/",
                           "washb_bangl_luminex_igg_seropos_pathogen_2026-01-29.rds")) %>%
  # final visit only
  filter(visit == 3) %>%
#  left_join(tx, by = join_by(clusterid)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tr)) %>%
  # Indicatior for WSH and Nutrition interventions
  mutate(wsh = ifelse(tr %in% c("WSH","Nutrition + WSH"), 1, 0), 
         nutr = ifelse(tr %in% c("Nutrition","Nutrition + WSH"), 1, 0),
         wshf = ifelse(wsh==1,"WASH","No WASH"),
         nutrf = ifelse(nutr==1,"Nutrition","No Nutrition"),
         wshf = factor(wshf, levels=c("No WASH","WASH")),
         nutrf = factor(nutrf, levels=c("No Nutrition","Nutrition")))
```

# Count of seropositive enteric pathogens

From SAP:

- Summarize the distribution of the number of seropositive pathogens (range 0–12) by treatment group at the final visit among all measured children.


```{r}
#| label: child-level count outcome

d_count <- d1 %>%
  group_by(block, clusterid, tr, childid, wsh, nutr, wshf, nutrf) %>%
  summarise(
    count_seropos = sum(seropos, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Quick check: range should be 0–12
d_count %>% summarise(min = min(count_seropos), max = max(count_seropos))

```



```{r seropos counts by treatment arm wash}
# select relevant columns for histogram
d_count_plot <- d_count %>%
  select(childid, wshf, count_seropos)

# group by treatment arm and seropos count, and count # children with each seropos count per treatment arm
d_count_hist1 <- d_count_plot %>%
  group_by(wshf, count_seropos) %>%
  summarize(
    nobs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# add columns 
# tot: total # children in each treatment arm 
# pct: percentage with seropos count per treatment arm
d_count_hist2 <- d_count_hist1 %>%
  group_by(wshf) %>%
  mutate(
    tot = sum(nobs),
    pct = nobs / tot 
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# fill in missing count values so the bars align
d_count_hist3 <- d_count_hist2 %>%
  tidyr::expand(wshf, count_seropos = full_seq(count_seropos, 1)) %>%
  left_join(d_count_hist2, by = c("wshf", "count_seropos")) %>%
  mutate(
    nobs = ifelse(is.na(nobs), 0, nobs),
    pct  = ifelse(is.na(pct), 0, pct)
  )


#create histogram
set.seed(123456)
x_breaks <- seq(0, max(d_count_hist3$count_seropos, na.rm = TRUE), by = 1)
x_limits <- c(min(x_breaks) - 0.5, max(x_breaks) + 0.5)

# group means (unadjusted, raw) to fold into the legend labels
# and report the raw between-group difference as a caption
grp_means_wsh <- d_count_plot %>%
  group_by(wshf) %>%
  summarise(mean_seropos = mean(count_seropos), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(wshf)

diff_wsh <- diff(grp_means_wsh$mean_seropos)  # WASH - No WASH (raw, unadjusted)

legend_labels_wsh <- with(grp_means_wsh, paste0(wshf, " (mean = ", round(mean_seropos, 2), ")"))

hist_count_seropos_wsh <- ggplot(data = d_count_hist3, aes(x = count_seropos, y = pct, fill = wshf)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cbpal_int[c(4,2)], labels = legend_labels_wsh) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, limits = x_limits) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of seropositive pathogens detected",
    y = "% children in each treatment group",
    fill = "Treatment group",
    tag = "A",
    caption = paste0("Mean difference (WASH − No WASH): ", round(diff_wsh, 2))
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )



#create boxplot
plot_bottom <- ggplot(data = d_count_plot, aes(x = count_seropos, y = wshf, color = wshf)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.1, width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", fill = NA, width = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cbpal_int[c(4,2)]) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, limits = x_limits) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )



#stack histogram and boxplot
final_plot <- hist_count_seropos_wsh / plot_bottom + plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1))

final_plot

```

# Estimate between-group differences using linear regression of the count outcome

- Linear regression with WSH, Nutrition, interaction, matched blocks

```{r}
#| label: test for interaction and fit regression
#----------------------------
# Fit interaction model first
#----------------------------
fit_int <- lm(count_seropos ~ wsh * nutr + factor(block), data = d_count)
V_int   <- sandwich::vcovCL(fit_int, cluster = d_count$clusterid)
ct_int  <- lmtest::coeftest(fit_int, vcov. = V_int)

p_int <- ct_int["wsh:nutr", "Pr(>|t|)"]
cat("p-val for interaction:", p_int)
#----------------------------------------------
# Decide final model based on interaction test
# No interaction here
#----------------------------------------------
if (!is.na(p_int) && p_int > 0.1) {
  fit <- lm(count_seropos ~ wshf + nutrf + factor(block), data = d_count)
} else {
  # If you prefer to still report marginal means even with interaction,
  # keep interaction but with factors (so emmeans works cleanly)
  fit<- lm(count_seropos ~ wshf * nutrf + factor(block), data = d_count)
}

v_final <- sandwich::vcovCL(fit, cluster = d_count$clusterid)

#----------------------------------------------
# Marginal means (WASH / Nutrition margins)
#----------------------------------------------
m_wash <- emmeans(fit, ~ wshf,  vcov = v_final)
m_nutr <- emmeans(fit, ~ nutrf, vcov = v_final)

m_wash
m_nutr
#----------------------------------------------
# Marginal contrasts (differences)
#----------------------------------------------
d_wash <- pairs(m_wash, reverse = TRUE)
d_nutr <- pairs(m_nutr, reverse = TRUE)
d_wash
d_nutr
```
